metadata.description: Experiments with gen-AI: Claude skills and plugins.

plugins.name: viky-gen-ai-factory
plugins.description: A growing collection of Claude skills: a citizen-friendly Indian law guide for people with no lawyer (describe any scenario - which law applies on those dates, BNS vs IPC, offences and what each needs to be proved, lawful defence options, rights on FIR/arrest/bail, free legal aid, an A-to-Z key-laws map, 13 legal domains with landmark cases, live-research protocol), and Tamil language help (careful writing, translation, proofreading, spelling/grammar checklists, and legal Tamil documents).
